entities.summary: Irving Carrie Taylor was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Ottawa RCAF Flyers who won the gold medal in ice hockey for Canada at the 1948 Winter Olympics in St. Moritz. Taylor died after complications due to stomach cancer at his home in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.
